comment: Per-desk facts the template requires. Copy this object per host. Unique dest facts keep country TLDs from looking like doorway pages. Google August 2026 Spam Update re-applies scaled-content and doorway policy — it is not a loophole to cloak or clone.
must_not: copy hipobuy.es Spain 58-line / 23.81 USD snapshot onto this dest
301 this TLD onto .net / now.com / a sister country TLD
put invite or coupon codes in <title>
coach a declared value or under-declaration
mass-generate city pages from this template
swap only the country name on otherwise identical HTML
must: local html lang + H1 search intent
catalogue on / with dated local-currency display
15 long Help FAQs that name this dest + customs source
homepage + Help #local briefing with dest-unique checkable facts (address format, estimator country, named customs URL, last-mile operator)
generation MUST FAIL if dest fingerprint is missing or a sister dest leaks into #local
FAQPage JSON-LD on Help; ItemList on News; Organization+ContactPoint on About
skip-to-content, og:locale, WebPage+WebSite+Organization on every page
dated lab note without inventing another agent's line count
independence footer; sister hosts stay separate files
